purpose: Mandatory guided initialization after SAFOR-MASTER.json is loaded. Establish provider, proven read/write access, owner namespace and project mode before package resolution or project materialization.

sequence.title: SAFOR Runtime prüfen
sequence.rule: Run before any provider/project operation. If recovery-control integrity or exact profile coverage cannot be proven, fail closed and do not attempt heuristic self-repair.

sequence.title: Wo arbeiten wir?
sequence.rule: The HUMAN explicitly selects GitHub or GitLab. Never silently choose a provider merely because a connection exists.

sequence.title: Zugriff prüfen
sequence.rule: Verify actual host/provider capabilities. Declarations in JSON are never proof of access.
sequence.humanBlockerMessage: Bitte verbinde {providerLabel} mit Lese- und Schreibrechten. Ohne diese Rechte kann SAFOR nicht starten.

sequence.title: Unter welchem Owner läuft das Projekt?
optionRules: Include the authenticated personal namespace when available.
Include organizations/groups visible to the authenticated identity.
Prefer namespaces where repository write capability can be verified.
Show owner display name and provider namespace handle; hide internal stable IDs behind Details.

sequence.title: Owner-Zugriff prüfen
sequence.rule: Re-verify access in the selected owner namespace because organization/group policy may be stricter than account-level access.
sequence.failMessage: Für diesen Owner fehlen mir noch die nötigen Lese-/Schreibrechte. Bitte gib sie frei oder wähle einen anderen Owner.

sequence.title: SAFOR Memory prüfen
sequence.rule: The repository `{selectedOwner}/safor-memory` must already exist and actual read/write access must be proven. SAFOR never creates this repository automatically.
sequence.stopMessage: Stopp. Unter diesem Owner fehlt ein nutzbares `safor-memory` oder die Lese-/Schreibrechte reichen nicht. Bitte richte `safor-memory` ein und starte SAFOR danach erneut.

sequence.title: Was möchtest du erstellen?
sequence.rule: Exactly one creation type is mandatory. Selection determines the Factory and compatible Operating Model used for Discovery, Planning and Evidence.

sequence.title: Welches Projekt nehmen wir?
repositoryEligibility: Repository belongs to or is accessible under the selected owner namespace.
Repository is not archived unless the HUMAN explicitly requests archived repositories.
Repository write access is proven for the project workflow baseline.

emptyState.message: In den letzten 7 Tagen wurde hier kein passendes Repository angefasst.

selectionVerification: Read repository metadata and stable ID.
Re-verify read/write access on the selected repository.
Persist the stable repository identity only after HUMAN selection.

sequence.title: Wie soll das neue Projekt heißen?
validation: Derive and show a valid project slug.
Check name/slug collision in selected owner namespace.
Do not create the repository before the HUMAN confirms the proposed project identity and setup scope.

sequence.title: SAFOR-Struktur vorbereiten
sequence.rule: Bind the already verified `{selectedOwner}/safor-memory` as the SAFOR control repository. A different control repository is not allowed in this baseline.

sequence.title: Arbeitsmodell auswählen
sequence.rule: Resolve the Provider Adapter and bind the Factory/Operating Model predetermined by CREATION_TYPE_SELECTION. HUMAN confirms the proposed bindings; do not silently substitute a different Factory.

sequence.title: Projekt starten
sequence.rule: After SETUP_APPROVAL, write and read back the project control structure including agents/index.json and master/scheduler/state.json. Initialization completes only after provider readback succeeds.

github.selectionRule: Use the most recent trustworthy repository activity timestamp exposed by the provider; prefer updated_at for broad project activity and retain pushed_at as supporting detail when available.

repositoryActivityNormalization.displayRule: Show only a human-readable relative or local date in the menu; keep raw timestamps in evidence/details.

permissionSemantics.explanation: SAFOR requires proven read/write access for its control and project workflow. Additional provider capabilities are requested only when the selected Factory or operation needs them.

buddyMessages.ownerPrompt: Unter welchem Owner läuft das Projekt?
buddyMessages.repoPrompt: Welches der zuletzt aktiven Projekte nehmen wir?
buddyMessages.ready: Alles sitzt. Projektkontrolle, Agenten-Registry und Scheduler sind sauber vorbereitet.
buddyMessages.safMemoryStopped: Stopp. Ohne `safor-memory` mit Lese- und Schreibrechten kann SAFOR nicht arbeiten.

safMemoryRepository.humanMessage: Für SAFOR brauchst du unter diesem Owner zwingend ein Repository namens `safor-memory` mit Lese- und Schreibrechten. Bitte richte es ein und starte SAFOR danach erneut.
safMemoryRepository.rule: Missing repository, unreadable repository or unproven write access is a hard initialization STOP. SAFOR must not create safor-memory automatically and must not continue to creation-type or project selection.

creationTypes.rule: The HUMAN must explicitly choose exactly one creation type. No default and no inference from repository contents.
